examples: Checklist after an expansion meeting
Follow-up call after a plant visit
check: Share the document checklist and propose a follow-up call.
control: Confirm the relationship manager has checked the recipient and date.
observations: The meeting record identifies two agreed follow-up actions.
The plant-visit note assigns a capacity questionnaire and a follow-up call to the relationship manager.

examples: Working-capital pack missing a forecast
Seasonal facility pack awaiting a bank reference
check: Check the bank reference and cash-flow forecast against the credit checklist.
control: Keep an incomplete pack with the analyst until the evidence request is reviewed.
observations: The intake lists the bank reference and forecast as outstanding.
The seasonal request includes its forecast. The checklist still requires a reference from the relationship bank.

examples: Two lenders disagree on the repayment schedule
Borrower draft changes reporting frequency
check: Compare the amortisation schedule and reporting frequency in the two drafts.
control: Check that counsel has reviewed the version pair before circulating the differences.
observations: The comparison records a changed amortisation schedule and reporting interval.
The borrower draft changes reporting from quarterly to monthly. The comparison marks that clause for the deal team.

examples: Interest cover below the review threshold
Quarterly covenant certificate awaiting verification
check: Check the interest-coverage calculation against the applicable covenant.
control: Escalate the exception for servicing review and preserve the waiver decision for the authorised officer.
observations: The synthetic certificate reports 2.10 times interest cover against a 2.50 threshold.
The signed quarterly certificate reports interest cover of 2.35 times against the file’s 2.50 threshold.

examples: A payment returned after the account closed
Return message awaiting a match to the original transfer
check: Check the return reason and its match to the original payment.
control: Require a human match before the exception is handed to Operations.
observations: The return is matched to the original transfer and carries an account-closed reason.
The returned transfer and original payment carry the same internal reference. The bank’s return code records a closed beneficiary account.

examples: Bill of lading shows a late shipment
A second presentation awaits shipment-date verification
check: Compare the shipped-on-board date with the last permitted shipment date.
control: Have Trade Finance confirm the discrepancy before a notice is prepared.
observations: The bill of lading is dated two days after the latest shipment date.
The transport record in the second presentation shows shipment one day after the latest permitted date.

examples: Forward value date awaiting confirmation
Hedge handover awaiting its approval record
check: Identify value-date and approval checks for the proposed FX handover.
control: Keep pricing and trade execution with the authorised dealing desk.
observations: The value date requires confirmation and the dealing approval is pending.
The hedge file records the value date. The internal approval field awaits an authorised dealer’s signature.

examples: Collateral in transit on a partial margin dispute
Counterparty valuation awaiting reconciliation
check: Reconcile the valuation and verify collateral in transit.
control: Keep the disputed part open for a human settlement decision.
observations: The statement separates the agreed balance from the disputed valuation.
The counterparty statement and internal valuation differ on one netting set. The remaining lines reconcile.

examples: Mandatory cash dividend notice
Dividend notice with an unverified record date
check: Verify the event type and participation terms on the dividend notice.
control: Ask custody staff to confirm record dates before preparing investor communications.
observations: The notice identifies a mandatory cash dividend and a local record date.
The second notice confirms the record date and refers the dividend election timetable to the custody reviewer.

examples: Signature page missing from an execution copy
Revised deal document awaiting counsel comparison
check: Check the signed pages against the secure execution checklist.
control: Keep the deal room and its execution checklist within the assigned team.
observations: The restricted file contains an execution copy with an outstanding signature page.
Counsel’s comparison identifies a change to the signature schedule in the revised execution copy.

examples: Forecast needs a label before publication
Release draft missing a disclosure check
check: Identify forecast labelling and disclosures requiring editorial review.
control: Keep release authority with the editor until the publication checks are complete.
observations: The forecast label and disclosure review are outstanding in the editorial copy.
The release checklist records editorial sign-off and an outstanding conflict-disclosure review.

examples: Exposure approaching an internal limit
Monitoring pack awaiting collateral confirmation
check: Check the exposure direction against the approved internal threshold.
control: Escalate the exposure finding to the credit officer for review.
observations: The internal monitoring record shows exposure approaching the review limit.
The monitoring pack records the collateral update separately from the exposure figure. The risk desk must reconcile them.

examples: Curve move pushes sensitivity above limit
Second limit event awaiting a driver check
check: Reconcile the sensitivity breach with its recorded market driver.
control: Have a risk officer verify the breach explanation before escalation.
observations: The report links the sensitivity excursion to a curve move.
The second limit event coincides with a shift in the short end of the curve. Independent review is pending.

examples: Calibration gap in a validation report
Challenger results awaiting a documentation check
check: Check the calibration finding and the supporting documentation gap.
control: Keep model acceptance and remediation ownership with the validation committee.
observations: The register contains an open calibration check and an incomplete methodology note.
The challenger test results are attached. The finding register still requires a methodology cross-reference.

examples: Reconciliation delay recorded as a near miss
A control repair awaiting incident classification
check: Check the near-miss classification against the reconciliation control record.
control: Have the responsible control owner verify the impact classification.
observations: The incident record describes a reconciliation near miss and a verification task.
The control owner documented a repair to the reconciliation check. The incident category awaits review.

examples: Wholesale outflow above the funding plan
Funding variance awaiting a driver sign-off
check: Compare the direction of the liquidity movement with the funding plan.
control: Have Treasury verify the variance driver before briefing the committee.
observations: The report attributes the variance to wholesale deposit outflow above plan.
The variance note traces the funding change to a delayed wholesale rollover. Treasury must sign off the attribution.

examples: Beneficial-owner address evidence outstanding
A renewal file awaiting checklist verification
check: Identify which beneficial-owner address evidence is missing.
control: Have the onboarding analyst check the request recipient and secure delivery channel.
observations: The verified checklist marks current beneficial-owner address evidence as outstanding.
The renewal checklist identifies an address declaration still due from a beneficial owner and assigns the follow-up to onboarding.

examples: Monitoring alert awaiting investigator handover
Screening review awaiting a source check
check: Check the internal evidence index and the investigation status.
control: Keep the case, its metadata and all handover material inside the assigned investigation team.
observations: The restricted index records the open review and authorised evidence pointers.
The restricted case index links a screening update to the investigator’s internal review queue.

examples: Notice periods differ between two clauses
Contract amendment awaiting clause verification
check: Check the notice-period mismatch between the two contract clauses.
control: Have counsel verify the exact wording in the internal contract record.
observations: The local comparison identifies different notice periods in the agreement and amendment.
The revised amendment changes the notice period from twenty to thirty business days. Counsel must review the clause.

examples: Order sequence awaiting surveillance review
Restricted order chronology awaiting verification
check: Check the internal order chronology against the surveillance evidence index.
control: Keep surveillance facts and reporting decisions with assigned compliance staff.
observations: The controlled index identifies the order sequence awaiting review.
The restricted index links an order amendment and cancellation to the chronology for the authorised reviewer.

examples: Access review missing its attestation
Follow-up sample awaiting an evidence check
check: Match the access-review exception to the evidence supporting the finding.
control: Keep the finding provisional until an independent audit reviewer signs.
observations: The audit index lists an access review with a missing attestation.
The follow-up sample includes the access log. The index identifies one outstanding manager attestation.

examples: Unmatched instrument in a prudential return
Reporting adjustment waiting for reference validation
check: Check the unmatched instrument reference against the reporting exception.
control: Have Finance verify the correction before a separate reporting submission.
observations: The register identifies an instrument reference without a matching reporting record.
The adjustment register ties one amended instrument reference to a reporting row that requires controller review.

examples: Scheduled reporting job delayed
Contained processing delay awaiting owner verification
check: Check the scheduled-job delay and the internal recovery status.
control: Keep operational details internal and have the service owner validate recovery.
observations: The synthetic service record shows a delayed scheduled job, containment and an assigned owner.
Service monitoring records a delayed batch that completed after restart. The recovery owner must verify closure.

examples: Payroll statement requested
Statement enquiry awaiting secure-channel verification
check: Check the routing category for the payroll statement request.
control: Have HR verify the private delivery channel before acknowledging the request.
observations: The HR checklist routes a payroll statement enquiry to the internal payroll team.
The routing checklist records that the employee selected the secure payroll channel for the statement enquiry.

examples: Support hours missing from a supplier bid
Renewal bid awaiting coverage verification
check: Compare the support-hour commitment with the tender requirement.
control: Ask procurement to review the clarification without ranking or awarding suppliers.
observations: The comparison identifies a support-hours requirement that needs supplier clarification.
The renewal bid covers weekday support. The requirements sheet also calls for weekend cover.

examples: Routine status update awaiting a board action owner
Committee action waiting for a due-date check
check: Check the category of the routine board action.
control: Have the secretary confirm the internal owner and due date before sending a reminder.
observations: The register identifies a routine status update for secretary review.
The committee register names an action owner. The proposed due date awaits the secretary’s confirmation.
